Coram : B.S. CHAUHAN*, F.M. IBRAHIM KALIFULLA
A B Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 - Or.21, r.1 and s.34 - Execution of decree - Amount payable under a decree - C Connotation of - Decree of Court making award passed by the arbitrator its rule - Part-payment of decretal amount by judgment debtor - Applicability of the rule of - Manner of calculation - Held: In stricto sensu, it is the decree which has to be applied in letter and D spirit in order to find out whether the stipulations contained therein were duly fulfilled by the judgment debtor - On facts, both the arbitral award as well as the Rule of the Court
Decision Date : 05-10-2012 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 7239/2012 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
